title: Price of a Covered Month on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement
content:
A covered month of next-period coverage on a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement is priced the way the agreement bills:

1. where the agreement's latest rent charge on the ledger is below its contracted monthly rent, the covered month is priced at that latest rent charge, as billed;
2. where the agreement carries the military discount but its latest rent charge is not below the contracted rent, the covered month is priced at the contracted rent less the class's military discount, rounded to the cent;
3. otherwise the covered month is priced at the contracted monthly rent.

The latest rent charge is the rent charge entry for the latest billed period on the agreement's ledger; the contracted monthly rent and the military discount flag are on the rental agreement record, and the discount rate is the class's rate on the class discount schedule.

## Decision table

| Latest rent charge compared with contracted rent | Military discount on the agreement | Covered month priced at |
|---|---|---|
| below | yes or no | the latest rent charge |
| not below | yes | contracted rent less the class's military discount |
| not below | no | the contracted rent |

## Hypothetical cases (contracted rent $160.00, class military discount 10%)

- Latest rent charge $80.00 (a first period at half off): $80.00.
- Latest rent charge $160.00, military discount carried: $144.00.
- Latest rent charge $160.00, no military discount: $160.00.
